name: Bidding Conditions
definition: Specifies the conditions under which securities can be acquired as part of a corporate action.

ProposedRate.name: Proposed Rate
ProposedRate.definition: Rate proposed in a remarketing of variable rate notes.

InformationToComplyWith.name: Information To Comply With
InformationToComplyWith.definition: Provides information conditions to the account owner that are to be complied with, eg, not open to US/Canadian residents, QIB or SIL to be provided.

SubscriptionCostDebitDate.name: Subscription Cost Debit Date
SubscriptionCostDebitDate.definition: Date by which cash must be in place in order to take part in the event.

ProrationRate.name: Proration Rate
ProrationRate.definition: Proportionate allocation used for the offer.

TransformationRate.name: Transformation Rate
TransformationRate.definition: Rate used to determine the cash consideration split across outturn settlement transactions that are the result of a transformation of the parent transaction.

ProrationDate.name: Proration Date
ProrationDate.definition: Date (and time) at which an issuer will determine the proration amount/quantity of an offer.

PercentageSought.name: Percentage Sought
PercentageSought.definition: Percentage of securities the offeror/issuer will purchase or redeem under the terms of the event. This can be a number or the term "any and all".

BidInterval.name: Bid Interval
BidInterval.definition: Acceptable price increment used for submitting a bid.

CalculationMethod.name: Calculation Method
CalculationMethod.definition: The method of calculation of drawings and partial redemptions.

AdditionalSubscriptionCost.name: Additional Subscription Cost
AdditionalSubscriptionCost.definition: Additional costs - coming on top of the subscription costs - which the subscriber should pay as per the subscription process.

MaximumAllowedOverSubscription.name: Maximum Allowed Over Subscription
MaximumAllowedOverSubscription.definition: A maximum percentage of shares available through the over subscription privilege, usually a percentage of the basic subscription shares, eg, an account owner subscribing to 100 shares may over subscribe to a maximum of 50 additional shares when the over subscription maximum is 50%.

ApplicableRate.name: Applicable Rate
ApplicableRate.definition: Rate applicable to the event announced, eg, redemption rate for a redemption event.

FrontEndOddLotQuantity.name: Front End Odd Lot Quantity
FrontEndOddLotQuantity.definition: Specifies that if an order is prorated holders of odd lots who tender their full position will not have tendered position prorated but rather accepted in full.

BackEndOddLotQuantity.name: Back End Odd Lot Quantity
BackEndOddLotQuantity.definition: Represents the presence of a back end odd lot provision and the quantity of equity required after proration to be eligible for this privilege.

CompulsoryPurchasePeriod.name: Compulsory Purchase Period
CompulsoryPurchasePeriod.definition: Period during a take-over where any outstanding equity must be purchased by the take-over company.

MaximumPrice.name: Maximum Price
MaximumPrice.definition: Maximum or cap price at which a holder can bid, e.g. on a Dutch auction offer.

MinimumPrice.name: Minimum Price
MinimumPrice.definition: Minimum or floor price at which a holder can bid, e.g. on a Dutch auction offer.

MaximumQuantity.name: Maximum Quantity
MaximumQuantity.definition: Maximum number of securities the offeror is requesting to complete the event.

MinimumQuantitySought.name: Minimum Quantity Sought
MinimumQuantitySought.definition: Minimum quantity of securities the offeror/issuer will purchase or redeem under the terms of the event. This can be a number or the term "any and all".

BaseDenomination.name: Base Denomination
BaseDenomination.definition: The minimum integral amount of securities that each account owner must have remaining after the called amounts are applied.

Event.name: Event
Event.definition: Event to which the bidding conditions apply.
